content.value_statement: Research agents need current web context and useful code examples, but broad queries can waste time. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured Exa workflow for searching, comparing, and refining technical research.
actual_capabilities: Guides use of exa_web_search for articles, documentation, news, and product comparisons.
Guides use of exa_get_code_context for examples, implementation patterns, and technical references.
Provides workflows for technology research, implementation research, comparison research, and discovery research.
Includes query optimization guidance for web search and code search tasks.
Documents recommended result counts, crawl options, and token ranges for different research depths.
Includes helper scripts for multi-step research workflows and query analysis.
limitations: Requires configured Exa tools and an Exa API key before searches can run.
Search results still need human review for accuracy, freshness, and source quality.
Helper scripts assume the local servers.exa import path exists in the host project.
It does not replace formal security, legal, medical, or financial review.

use_cases.title: Research a new framework
use_cases.description: Find current overview material, starter examples, and best practices before choosing an implementation path.

use_cases.title: Compare technical options
use_cases.description: Collect comparison articles and code examples for two tools before making an architecture recommendation.

use_cases.title: Track emerging tools
use_cases.description: Discover recent tools in a category and review practical examples for promising options.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner topic overview
prompt_templates.scenario: Start learning a technology or concept.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research {technology} for a beginner. Find recent overview sources, key features, common use cases, and two reliable next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Implementation guide search
prompt_templates.scenario: Learn how to build a specific feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research how to implement {feature} in {framework}. Include current guides, practical code examples, common pitfalls, and recommended search refinements.

prompt_templates.title: Technology comparison brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare {option A} and {option B} for {project context}. Use current web research and code examples. Summarize tradeoffs, migration risk, and recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced research workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a complete decision-ready research brief.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a research brief for {topic}. Combine web search, code context, source validation, query refinement, and a final recommendation with confidence levels.

output_examples.input: Research Next.js 15 for a frontend migration.
output_examples.output: A concise brief with recent feature summaries, migration concerns, implementation examples, source notes, and recommended follow-up searches.

output_examples.input: Compare Prisma and Drizzle for a small SaaS app.
output_examples.output: A comparison covering ecosystem maturity, schema workflow, runtime tradeoffs, example patterns, and a recommendation matched to the project context.

output_examples.input: Find current AI coding assistants and practical usage examples.
output_examples.output: A discovery report listing notable tools, recent articles, integration examples, strengths, limitations, and questions for deeper evaluation.

best_practices: Start broad, then refine searches based on the first useful sources.
Use web search for current context and code search for implementation details.
Validate important claims across multiple sources before making recommendations.
anti_patterns: Do not use one-word queries when a framework, feature, or goal is known.
Do not treat search output as verified truth without source review.
Do not request large code context when a focused example is enough.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It gives AI agents structured workflows for Exa web search, code context search, query refinement, and technical research summaries.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The README says Exa tools need an Exa API key configured in a local environment file.

faq.question: Can it find code examples?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents exa_get_code_context for finding examples, implementation patterns, and technical documentation.

faq.question: Can it research current information?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends live crawling and year-specific queries for recent articles, releases, and tool updates.

faq.question: Does it verify every source automatically?
faq.answer: No. Users should review sources, compare multiple results, and validate important claims before acting.
